source.other: When Chat’Karuth died, he was an old man, father to three strong and ambitious sons, and warlord to an army that could match any enemy willing to rise against the ancient forests. Though at the end of his glorious reign, Chat’Karuth chose his eldest son, Thron, to succeed him as the tribe’s warlord – a decision that left his two brothers unsatisfied. The old warlord knew that. As his father instructed him, Thron left the capital of Al’thunran, the home of the Throne Among the Trees, and withdrew his forces to the high hills where he buried the corpse of his father. There he swore to the gods and his father’s spirit that he’d return to re-established order. While his brothers have raged blind war against Thron and the few forces he left to secure the borders of Al’thunran, the young warlord seeks to reunite his ambitious brothers and force the tribes to march once again under a common banner.

target.other: När Chat’Karuth dog var han en gammal man, far till tre starka och ambitiösa söner och krigsherre över en armé som kunde mäta sig med varje fiende som vågade resa sig mot de uråldriga skogarna. I slutet av sin ärorika regering utsåg Chat’Karuth sin äldste son Thron till stammens krigsherre efter honom – ett beslut som lämnade de två bröderna missnöjda. Den gamle krigsherren visste det. På sin fars uppmaning lämnade Thron huvudstaden Al’thunran, hem för Tronen bland träden, och drog tillbaka sina styrkor till de höga kullarna där han begravde sin fars kropp. Där svor han vid gudarna och sin fars ande att återvända och återställa ordningen. Medan hans bröder för ett blint krig mot Thron och de få styrkor han lämnade för att säkra Al’thunrans gränser försöker den unge krigsherren återförena sina ambitiösa bröder och tvinga stammarna att åter marschera under en gemensam fana.

key: When Chat’Karuth died, he was an old man, father to three strong and ambitious sons, and warlord to an army that could match any enemy willing to rise against the ancient forests. Though at the end of his glorious reign, Chat’Karuth chose his eldest son, Thron, to succeed him as the tribe’s warlord – a decision that left his two brothers unsatisfied. The old warlord knew that. As his father instructed him, Thron left the capital of Al’thunran, the home of the Throne Among the Trees, and withdrew his forces to the high hills where he buried the corpse of his father. There he swore to the gods and his father’s spirit that he’d return to re-established order. While his brothers have raged blind war against Thron and the few forces he left to secure the borders of Al’thunran, the young warlord seeks to reunite his ambitious brothers and force the tribes to march once again under a common banner.

source.other: Six months ago, Lutius – a young general of the Empire – was sent with 150 soldiers to the frontier beyond the northern forests where Barbarian tribes were crossing onto land held by the Empire. His task was to defend the Empire’s land. At first, everything was calm. He even talked to a few Barbarian children and thought about a peaceful life – side by side with this archaic folk. He began to feel safer and his army began to drop their attention off the potential enemy. That was their undoing. One night in March his unprepared army was attacked by 100 Barbarian footmen and was completely scattered. Only with his bare life he and a handful of his soldiers survived.

target.other: För sex månader sedan skickades Lutius – en ung general i Imperiet – med 150 soldater till gränstrakterna bortom de norra skogarna, där barbarstammar tog sig in på mark som hölls av Imperiet. Hans uppgift var att försvara Imperiets land. Till en början var allt lugnt. Han pratade till och med med några barbarbarn och funderade på ett fredligt liv – sida vid sida med detta ålderdomliga folk. Han började känna sig tryggare och hans armé sänkte sin beredskap inför den möjliga fienden. Det blev deras undergång. En natt i mars anfölls hans oförberedda armé av 100 barbariska fotsoldater och skingrades helt. Han och en handfull soldater undkom med blotta livet.

key: Six months ago, Lutius – a young general of the Empire – was sent with 150 soldiers to the frontier beyond the northern forests where Barbarian tribes were crossing onto land held by the Empire. His task was to defend the Empire’s land. At first, everything was calm. He even talked to a few Barbarian children and thought about a peaceful life – side by side with this archaic folk. He began to feel safer and his army began to drop their attention off the potential enemy. That was their undoing. One night in March his unprepared army was attacked by 100 Barbarian footmen and was completely scattered. Only with his bare life he and a handful of his soldiers survived.

source.other: When their God lost faith in the Atlanteans and drowned their island, one woman’s struggle for justice and a second chance for her people would become the stuff of legends. Leading the remaining Atlanteans into a new future in a new part of the World, Jundlina became the most powerful human of her time, but at a high cost: her humanity and soul.

target.other: När deras gud förlorade tron på atlanterna och dränkte deras ö blev en kvinnas kamp för rättvisa och en andra chans för hennes folk stoff till legender. Genom att leda de återstående atlanterna mot en ny framtid i en ny del av världen blev Jundlina sin tids mäktigaste människa, men till ett högt pris: sin mänsklighet och sin själ.

key: When their God lost faith in the Atlanteans and drowned their island, one woman’s struggle for justice and a second chance for her people would become the stuff of legends. Leading the remaining Atlanteans into a new future in a new part of the World, Jundlina became the most powerful human of her time, but at a high cost: her humanity and soul.

source.other: Living off the ocean is a constant struggle, and even more so for the inhabitants of the Frisian North Sea shore. Was the last storm flood, the most devastating one in human memory, really nothing more than yet another example for the hardships all Frisians have to face – or a sign from the gods that a tribe that only just settled here must seek out an entirely new home?

target.other: Att leva av vad havet ger är en ständig kamp, än mer för de frisiska invånarna vid Nordsjöns kust. Var den senaste stormfloden, den mest förödande i mannaminne, bara ännu ett exempel på de vedermödor alla friser måste möta – eller ett tecken från gudarna på att en stam som nyss har slagit sig ner här måste söka ett helt nytt hem?

key: Living off the ocean is a constant struggle, and even more so for the inhabitants of the Frisian North Sea shore. Was the last storm flood, the most devastating one in human memory, really nothing more than yet another example for the hardships all Frisians have to face – or a sign from the gods that a tribe that only just settled here must seek out an entirely new home?

target.other: Malac’ Mors stränder

source.other: After losing an important battle against the Barbarians which lead to the loss of a big part of the Empire’s territory, Lutius leaves Fremil to start a new life. But his destiny takes his ship into a heavy storm, which nearly destroys it. Only with a lot of luck he manages to beach his damaged ship on an unknown desert strand and save his people. For now.

target.other: Efter att ha förlorat en viktig strid mot barbarerna, som ledde till att en stor del av Imperiets territorium gick förlorat, lämnar Lutius Fremil för att börja ett nytt liv. Men en kraftig storm driver honom och hans skepp mot undergång. Endast tack vare stor tur lyckas han sätta sitt skadade skepp på grund på en okänd öde strand och rädda sitt folk. För stunden.

key: After losing an important battle against the Barbarians which lead to the loss of a big part of the Empire’s territory, Lutius leaves Fremil to start a new life. But his destiny takes his ship into a heavy storm, which nearly destroys it. Only with a lot of luck he manages to beach his damaged ship on an unknown desert strand and save his people. For now.

source.other: On their way home to defend the Empire, the crew of Lutius was surprised by the will of the gods.

target.other: På väg hem för att försvara Imperiet överrumplas Lutius besättning av gudarnas vilja.

key: On their way home to defend the Empire, the crew of Lutius was surprised by the will of the gods.

source.other: In 1362, the quiet, peaceful life of the inhabitants of the Northern Frisian Islands was disrupted by one of the greatest storm floods in human memory: Saint Marcellus’ Flood. Is it really nothing more than yet another storm, or a sign from the Gods that the Frisian community on the island of Langeness is not wanted here?

target.other: År 1362 avbröts det stillsamma, fredliga livet för invånarna på de nordfrisiska öarna av en av de största stormfloderna i mannaminne: Sankt Marcellusfloden. Är den verkligen bara ännu en storm, eller ett tecken från gudarna på att det frisiska samhället på ön Langeness inte är välkommet här?

key: In 1362, the quiet, peaceful life of the inhabitants of the Northern Frisian Islands was disrupted by one of the greatest storm floods in human memory: Saint Marcellus’ Flood. Is it really nothing more than yet another storm, or a sign from the Gods that the Frisian community on the island of Langeness is not wanted here?

source.other: Claus and Henneke Lembeck have reached the North at last. But will they be able to convince Reebaud to send them aid?

target.other: Claus och Henneke Lembeck har äntligen nått norr. Men kommer de att kunna övertyga Reebaud att skicka hjälp?

key: Claus and Henneke Lembeck have reached the North at last. But will they be able to convince Reebaud to send them aid?

source.other: Back in Northern Frisia at last, Claus, Henneke, and Reebaud are preparing for battle against the invaders. They must gather allies and plan their strategy, but the foe is never far away…

target.other: Tillbaka i norra Frisia till sist förbereder sig Claus, Henneke och Reebaud för strid mot inkräktarna. De måste samla allierade och planera sin strategi, men fienden är aldrig långt borta …

key: Back in Northern Frisia at last, Claus, Henneke, and Reebaud are preparing for battle against the invaders. They must gather allies and plan their strategy, but the foe is never far away…

source.other: In this tutorial, you will learn how to navigate in Widelands and how to build buildings and roads.

target.other: I den här handledningen lär du dig att navigera i Widelands samt bygga byggnader och vägar.

key: In this tutorial, you will learn how to navigate in Widelands and how to build buildings and roads.

source.other: In this tutorial, you will be taught the secrets of warfare: how to create soldiers, how to train them and how to lead them in battle. Scouting will be also covered.

target.other: I den här handledningen får du lära dig krigets hemligheter: hur du framställer soldater, tränar dem och leder dem i strid. Även spaning ingår.

key: In this tutorial, you will be taught the secrets of warfare: how to create soldiers, how to train them and how to lead them in battle. Scouting will be also covered.

source.other: In this tutorial, you will get to know seafaring, which is how to handle ships and ports, and how to use ferries and waterways.

target.other: I den här handledningen lär du känna sjöfarten: hur man hanterar skepp och hamnar samt använder färjor och farleder.

key: In this tutorial, you will get to know seafaring, which is how to handle ships and ports, and how to use ferries and waterways.

source.other: Large plots are rare on those small islands. Prioritize construction of large buildings on them. Sometimes you will need big military buildings to expand all the way to the next island. The AI will perform poorly.

target.other: Stora byggnadsplatser är sällsynta på dessa små öar. Prioritera att bygga stora byggnader där det går. Ibland behövs stora militärbyggnader för att kunna expandera hela vägen till nästa ö. AI:n fungerar dåligt i den här miljön.

key: Large plots are rare on those small islands. Prioritize construction of large buildings on them. Sometimes you will need big military buildings to expand all the way to the next island. The AI will perform poorly.

source.other: Who will be the real king of the big atoll?

target.other: Vem blir den verklige kungen över den stora atollen?

key: Who will be the real king of the big atoll?

source.other: It’s a pleasure to settle in the beauty of this fissured countryside. But the ways to encompass these large territories are long and meandering, so it is easy to err into the land of the foreign clans.

target.other: Det är ett nöje att bosätta sig i denna vackra, spruckna landsbygd. Men vägarna genom de här stora områdena är långa och slingrande, så det är lätt att hamna på främmande klaners mark.

key: It’s a pleasure to settle in the beauty of this fissured countryside. But the ways to encompass these large territories are long and meandering, so it is easy to err into the land of the foreign clans.

source.other: Whether just one of nature’s strangest features or the creation of a mad (and game-hungry) god, this weird battleground awaits two opponents for another confrontation.

target.other: Oavsett om det är ett av naturens märkligaste fenomen eller en galen (och spelhungrig) guds skapelse väntar detta märkliga slagfält på två motståndare inför ännu en drabbning.

key: Whether just one of nature’s strangest features or the creation of a mad (and game-hungry) god, this weird battleground awaits two opponents for another confrontation.

source.other: A few miles in front of Gerion Coast lies a small unnamed island. Until now, you have not seen any reason to sail there, but yesterday a big fireball came from the sky and touched down in its center. Is this a sign of the Gods? You believe it is and you hope that your tribe will find the treasure of this island before other tribes will follow.

target.other: Några mil från Gerionkusten ligger en liten namnlös ö. Fram till nu har du inte sett någon anledning att styra dina skepp dit. Men igår kom ett stort eldklot från himlen och landade mitt på ön. Är det ett tecken från gudarna? Du tror det och hoppas att din stam hittar öns skatt innan andra stammar följer efter.

key: A few miles in front of Gerion Coast lies a small unnamed island. Until now, you have not seen any reason to sail there, but yesterday a big fireball came from the sky and touched down in its center. Is this a sign of the Gods? You believe it is and you hope that your tribe will find the treasure of this island before other tribes will follow.

source.other: Red player is close to the ores, but has little fertile terrain. Yellow player has plenty of good land, but must move far from his starting position to find ores. Blue player takes the middle ground – he has some fertile land and is not too far away from the resources.

target.other: Den röda spelaren har nära till malmen men ont om bördig mark. Den gula spelaren har gott om bra mark men måste röra sig långt från sin startposition för att hitta malm. Den blå spelaren har mark mellan de andra och har både bördig mark och relativt nära till resurserna.

key: Red player is close to the ores, but has little fertile terrain. Yellow player has plenty of good land, but must move far from his starting position to find ores. Blue player takes the middle ground – he has some fertile land and is not too far away from the resources.

source.other: Man your ship and sail to the horizon.

target.other: Bemanna ditt skepp och segla mot horisonten.

key: Man your ship and sail to the horizon.

source.other: The jewel of the alps, the dolomites mountain range has been declared a world heritage site for its pristine beauty. This map is an as-faithful-as-reasonable reconstruction of the area delimited by Cortina d’Ampezzo in the north-east and Canazei in the south-west. If you have to be pitted in a duel to the death with your enemies, it may as well be in a beautiful place.

target.other: Alpernas juvel, Dolomiternas bergskedja, har utsetts till världsarv för sin enastående skönhet. Denna karta är en så verklighetstrogen rekonstruktion som rimligen är möjlig av området mellan Cortina d’Ampezzo i nordost och Canazei i sydväst. Om du måste utkämpa en duell på liv och död mot dina fiender kan det lika gärna ske på en vacker plats.

key: The jewel of the alps, the dolomites mountain range has been declared a world heritage site for its pristine beauty. This map is an as-faithful-as-reasonable reconstruction of the area delimited by Cortina d’Ampezzo in the north-east and Canazei in the south-west. If you have to be pitted in a duel to the death with your enemies, it may as well be in a beautiful place.

source.other: The mountains have an abundance of flat ground. Unfortunately, most of it is vertical – use the little building space you have wisely. A fortress at the mouth of a narrow mountain pass can be a formidable obstacle to an enemy army – use the terrain to your advantage. Chop all trees and expand wherever you can – it’s the only way to find all the precious farm spaces.

target.other: Bergen har ett överflöd av plan mark. Tyvärr är det mesta vertikalt – använd det lilla byggutrymme du har klokt. En fästning vid mynningen av ett smalt bergspass kan vara ett formidabelt hinder för en fientlig armé – använd terrängen till din fördel. Hugg ner alla träd och expandera där du kan – det är enda sättet att hitta alla värdefulla odlingsytor.

key: The mountains have an abundance of flat ground. Unfortunately, most of it is vertical – use the little building space you have wisely. A fortress at the mouth of a narrow mountain pass can be a formidable obstacle to an enemy army – use the terrain to your advantage. Chop all trees and expand wherever you can – it’s the only way to find all the precious farm spaces.

source.other: Ships are your best fellows. Starting positions are similar, so the map should be fair.

target.other: Skepp är dina bästa vänner. Startpositionerna är likvärdiga, så kartan bör vara rättvis.

key: Ships are your best fellows. Starting positions are similar, so the map should be fair.

source.other: This is a somewhat technical map, and it is best suited for two or three human players. Coal is hard to find – consider making some. There is gold near the starting point – do you see it?

target.other: Detta är en något teknisk karta som passar bäst för två eller tre mänskliga spelare. Kol är svårt att hitta – överväg att producera eget. Det finns guld nära startplatsen – ser du det?

key: This is a somewhat technical map, and it is best suited for two or three human players. Coal is hard to find – consider making some. There is gold near the starting point – do you see it?

source.other: These are the beautiful Finnish lands of lakes, rivers, ancient forests and mountains. It is up to you to find a way through these lands.

target.other: Detta är de vackra finska markerna med sina sjöar, älvar, urskogar och berg. Det är upp till dig att hitta en väg genom landet.

key: These are the beautiful Finnish lands of lakes, rivers, ancient forests and mountains. It is up to you to find a way through these lands.

source.other: Is this a test by the Gods or an evil plan by someone else, that you and your tribe woke up on this island among fire and lava? Until now it seems as if you are alone, but no-one knows what might happen if you met an opposing tribe?

target.other: Är det gudarnas prövning eller någon annans ondskefulla plan att du och din stam vaknar upp på denna ö, omgivna av eld och lava? Hittills har det verkat som om ni är ensamma, men ingen vet vad som kan hända om ni möter en fientlig stam?

key: Is this a test by the Gods or an evil plan by someone else, that you and your tribe woke up on this island among fire and lava? Until now it seems as if you are alone, but no-one knows what might happen if you met an opposing tribe?

source.other: I: Water can be found along the river. II: Snowmen mark additional water sources. III: Each mountain contains only one resource.

target.other: I: Vatten finns längs floden. II: Snögubbar markerar ytterligare vattenkällor. III: Varje berg innehåller bara en resurstyp.

key: I: Water can be found along the river. II: Snowmen mark additional water sources. III: Each mountain contains only one resource.

source.other: Whether it is the latest solstice, or lunar illness, something moves these tribes towards their final ordeal.

target.other: Oavsett om det är det senaste solståndet eller månens illvilja, driver något dessa stammar mot deras sista prövning.

key: Whether it is the latest solstice, or lunar illness, something moves these tribes towards their final ordeal.

source.other: For centuries, you’ve lived peacefully side by side with the other tribe on the neighboring island. This peace seems to come to an end now – your neighbor has begun to expand.

target.other: I århundraden har ni levt fredligt sida vid sida med den andra stammen på grannön. Den här freden verkar nu gå mot sitt slut – er granne har börjat expandera.

key: For centuries, you’ve lived peacefully side by side with the other tribe on the neighboring island. This peace seems to come to an end now – your neighbor has begun to expand.

source.other: An old legend tells that these seven kingdoms, that have flourished for ages in prosperity, will someday collapse into a devastating war. Has your latest betrayal been one too many and will the prophecy come true?

target.other: En gammal legend säger att dessa sju kungariken, som har frodats i välstånd i århundraden, en dag kommer att störta samman i ett förödande krig. Har ditt senaste svek blivit ett för mycket, och kommer profetian att gå i uppfyllelse?

key: An old legend tells that these seven kingdoms, that have flourished for ages in prosperity, will someday collapse into a devastating war. Has your latest betrayal been one too many and will the prophecy come true?

source.other: This lake, deep in the most ancient forests, has long been known for its beauty and idyllic peace. However, its sanctity has been disturbed now, as two hostile tribes have arrived at its shores…

target.other: Djupt inne i de uråldriga skogarna ligger denna sjö, som länge har varit känd för sin skönhet och sitt idylliska lugn. Men dess helgd har nu kränkts när två fientliga stammar har anlänt till dess stränder …

key: This lake, deep in the most ancient forests, has long been known for its beauty and idyllic peace. However, its sanctity has been disturbed now, as two hostile tribes have arrived at its shores…

source.other: Don’t forget to take care of your timber supplies, you’ll need them.

target.other: Glöm inte ditt timmerförråd, du kommer att behöva det.

key: Don’t forget to take care of your timber supplies, you’ll need them.

source.other: A fair 8-player map with natural geographic features dividing land. The geographic features are meant to be somewhat realistic with rivers flowing from glaciers in the mountains through hills and flatlands into the sea. Gold is a much rarer resource compared to coal and iron. Different resources are often found at some distance to each other.

target.other: En rättvis karta för åtta spelare med naturliga geografiska formationer som delar upp landet. Formationerna ska vara någorlunda realistiska, med floder som rinner från glaciärerna i bergen genom kullar och slättland ut i havet. Guld är en betydligt sällsyntare resurs än kol och järn. Olika resurser finns ofta en bit från varandra.

key: A fair 8-player map with natural geographic features dividing land. The geographic features are meant to be somewhat realistic with rivers flowing from glaciers in the mountains through hills and flatlands into the sea. Gold is a much rarer resource compared to coal and iron. Different resources are often found at some distance to each other.

source.other: A special tournament in Atlantean culture is the so-called ‘Island Hopping’, where two or more groups try to reach the center island as fast as possible, to be the first erecting a castle on the top of the central mountain.

target.other: En särskild tävling i den atlantiska kulturen är den så kallade ”ö-hoppningen”, där två eller fler grupper försöker nå centralön så snabbt som möjligt för att först uppföra ett slott på toppen av det centrala berget.

key: A special tournament in Atlantean culture is the so-called ‘Island Hopping’, where two or more groups try to reach the center island as fast as possible, to be the first erecting a castle on the top of the central mountain.

source.other: In the vicinity of three major volcanoes, six lovely islands are inviting settlers to start a new life. Deserts and a quickly growing forest wait to be discovered. But only by becoming a naval power will your tribe be able to explore enough resources to compete with its opponents.

target.other: I närheten av tre stora vulkaner inbjuder sex underbara öar nybyggare att starta ett nytt liv. Öknar och en snabbt växande skog väntar på att bli upptäckta. Men bara genom att bli en sjömakt kan din stam utforska tillräckligt med resurser för att kunna konkurrera med motståndarna.

key: In the vicinity of three major volcanoes, six lovely islands are inviting settlers to start a new life. Deserts and a quickly growing forest wait to be discovered. But only by becoming a naval power will your tribe be able to explore enough resources to compete with its opponents.

source.other: This map is intended as a solo challenge for those very skilled players that find 1 vs 6 against the AI too easy. Blue player has no metal (except a bit of iron to kickstart your economy), so you have to rely on the 5% production of an empty mine. And you’re still 1 vs 6 (though of course you can remove some AI players to make it a bit easier). Good luck!

target.other: Den här kartan är avsedd som en soloutmaning för mycket skickliga spelare som tycker att 1 mot 6 mot AI:n är för lätt. Den blå spelaren har ingen metall, förutom lite järn för att få igång ekonomin, så du måste förlita dig på en tom gruvas produktion på 5 %. Och du spelar fortfarande 1 mot 6, även om du förstås kan ta bort några AI-spelare för att göra det lite lättare. Lycka till!

key: This map is intended as a solo challenge for those very skilled players that find 1 vs 6 against the AI too easy. Blue player has no metal (except a bit of iron to kickstart your economy), so you have to rely on the 5% production of an empty mine. And you’re still 1 vs 6 (though of course you can remove some AI players to make it a bit easier). Good luck!

source.other: Only a small hill in the centre of the map connects these four competing tribes. Lead your army to this hill right away and build a giant stronghold as a sign of your superiority!

target.other: Bara en liten kulle i mitten av kartan förbinder dessa fyra tävlande stammar. Led genast din armé till denna kulle och bygg en väldig fästning som ett tecken på din överlägsenhet!

key: Only a small hill in the centre of the map connects these four competing tribes. Lead your army to this hill right away and build a giant stronghold as a sign of your superiority!

source.other: Each player has a different obstacle to expansion, and there’s always more than one way to overcome it. While the AI can be defeated here without building a single ship, players are advised to make ports and shipyards a priority – expeditions are universally useful and are often the fastest way to gold deposits.

target.other: Varje spelare har ett eget hinder för expansion, och det finns alltid mer än ett sätt att ta sig förbi det. Även om AI-spelarna kan besegras här utan att bygga ett enda skepp rekommenderas spelarna att prioritera hamnar och skeppsvarv – expeditioner är allmänt användbara och ofta den snabbaste vägen till guldförekomster.

key: Each player has a different obstacle to expansion, and there’s always more than one way to overcome it. While the AI can be defeated here without building a single ship, players are advised to make ports and shipyards a priority – expeditions are universally useful and are often the fastest way to gold deposits.

source.other: It is the land where the sun is hardly seen during the winter and where spring floods away any reminiscence of the past. Strange tensions have grown among its residents and many selfish rulers have taken advantage of the chaos. The superstitious people appear to be no obstacle for the developments of better equipped armies. Tough times are on the brink of emerging, and you should heed the words of your wise advisors, or fade into oblivion like the others.

target.other: Det är ett land där solen knappt syns under vintern och där vårfloden sköljer bort alla minnen av det förflutna. Märkliga spänningar har vuxit fram bland invånarna och många själviska härskare har dragit nytta av kaoset. Det vidskepliga folket verkar inte utgöra något hinder för utvecklingen av bättre utrustade arméer. Svåra tider är på väg, och du bör lyssna till dina visa rådgivares ord, annars bleknar du i glömska som de andra.

key: It is the land where the sun is hardly seen during the winter and where spring floods away any reminiscence of the past. source.other: You are standing on an island, crowned by mighty mountains which keep a wonderful and mighty treasure in their middle – The Green Plateau, which is hard to conquer but easy to lose. So, if you want it, be aware of the other clans.

target.other: Du står på en ö, krönt av mäktiga berg vars mitt döljer en underbar och mäktig skatt – den gröna platån, som är svår att erövra men lätt att förlora. Om du vill ha den bör du se upp för de andra klanerna.

key: You are standing on an island, crowned by mighty mountains which keep a wonderful and mighty treasure in their middle – The Green Plateau, which is hard to conquer but easy to lose. So, if you want it, be aware of the other clans.

source.other: It smells like swamp, it looks like swamp and it is a swamp. But it is the place you were born and where you’ve lived your whole life. If you don’t want to lose it, defend it!

target.other: Det luktar som ett träsk, det ser ut som ett träsk och det är ett träsk. Men det är platsen där du föddes och har levt hela ditt liv. Om du inte vill förlora den, försvara den!

key: It smells like swamp, it looks like swamp and it is a swamp. But it is the place you were born and where you’ve lived your whole life. If you don’t want to lose it, defend it!

source.other: Welcome, intruder! You’re like a European conqueror from the early 1800s when they settled the Van Diemen land – later known as Tasmania. Between 1828 and 1832 there was a war called the Black War in which the British Empire eradicated almost the entire Aboriginal population of the Van Diemen land. – The map simulates a scattered British Empire but without any advantages – actually it offers some great disadvantages and you will likely have a hard time conquering Tasmania. During the historical Black War the ratio between Europeans and Aboriginals was around one against ten, but this time they’re armed to the teeth for a rematch.

target.other: Välkommen, inkräktare! Du är som en europeisk erövrare från början av 1800-talet, när de bosatte sig i Van Diemen-landet – senare känt som Tasmanien. Mellan 1828 och 1832 utkämpades ett krig som kallades Svarta kriget, där det brittiska imperiet utrotade nästan hela den aboriginska befolkningen i Van Diemen-landet. – Kartan simulerar ett splittrat brittiskt imperium utan några fördelar – tvärtom erbjuder den stora nackdelar, och du kommer sannolikt att få svårt att erövra Tasmanien. Under det historiska Svarta kriget var förhållandet mellan européer och aboriginer ungefär ett mot tio, men den här gången är de beväpnade till tänderna för en returmatch.

key: Welcome, intruder! You’re like a European conqueror from the early 1800s when they settled the Van Diemen land – later known as Tasmania. Between 1828 and 1832 there was a war called the Black War in which the British Empire eradicated almost the entire Aboriginal population of the Van Diemen land. – The map simulates a scattered British Empire but without any advantages – actually it offers some great disadvantages and you will likely have a hard time conquering Tasmania. During the historical Black War the ratio between Europeans and Aboriginals was around one against ten, but this time they’re armed to the teeth for a rematch.

source.other: This map is intended to be played by a single player from the blue player’s starting location as Empire. Choose Barbarians and Amazons for the rival tribes. If you want a challenge, put them all on the same side and disable Diplomacy. Or you can play with every player against all others, with a win condition of Territorial Time. This map isn’t suitable for short games and one game will likely take more than ten hours. The AI has great capability on this map. One of the computer players will likely also begin seafaring and competing for the best harbor places on the Tasmanian coast, so you’ve been warned!

target.other: Den här kartan är avsedd för en ensam spelare som spelar Imperiet från den blå spelarens startposition. Välj barbarer och amasoner som rivaliserande stammar. Om du vill ha en utmaning kan du placera dem alla på samma sida och inaktivera diplomati. Du kan också låta alla spelare möta alla andra med vinstvillkoret territoriell tid. Kartan lämpar sig inte för korta spel och en omgång kommer sannolikt att ta mer än tio timmar. AI:n är mycket kompetent på denna karta. En av datorspelarna kommer troligen också att börja med sjöfart och tävla om de bästa hamnplatserna på Tasmaniens kust, så du är varnad!

One of the computer players will likely also begin seafaring and competing for the best harbor places on the Tasmanian coast, so you’ve been warned!

source.other: Some say that impenetrable lands to the far north scared away even the most courageous settlers and the bravest of the brave warriors. Big and old forests, full of big and predatory game, cut across by wetlands and hills were shrouded in mystery. The ones who had managed to come back mentioned tremendous buildings, decorated with carvings and gold from majestic mountain ranges somewhere amongst the wilderness. Dozens of years after only some crumbly ruins remain of these good old times, covered with moss and trees. Their shapes give only an idea about the craftsmanship of ancient constructors. Nobody knows why they (have) disappeared. Nobody knows why. People say that now nothing is blocking the road to wealth. But many will die pulled apart by wolves, engulfed by swamp… encircled by hostile tribes.

target.other: Vissa säger att ogenomträngliga marker långt uppe i den avlägsna norden skrämde iväg även de modigaste nybyggarna och de tappraste av de tappra krigarna. Stora, gamla skogar, fulla av rovdjur och genomskurna av våtmarker och kullar, var insvepta i mystik. De som hade lyckats komma tillbaka därifrån nämnde enorma byggnader, dekorerade med träsniderier och guld från majestätiska bergskedjor någonstans i vildmarken. Flera decennier senare återstår bara några sönderfallande ruiner från dessa gamla goda tider, täckta av mossa och träd. Deras former ger bara en antydan om de forntida byggarnas hantverksskicklighet. Ingen vet varför de försvann. Folk säger att nu finns inget som blockerar vägen till rikedom, men många kommer att dö sönderslitna av vargar, uppslukade av träsk eller omringade av fientliga stammar.

Nobody knows why they (have) disappeared. Nobody knows why. People say that now nothing is blocking the road to wealth. source.other: Another strange test by the Gods. To reach the other side, there seems to be no other way but to occupy the land of your enemies.

target.other: Ytterligare en märklig prövning från gudarna. Det verkar inte finnas något annat sätt att nå den andra sidan än att ockupera dina fienders land.

key: Another strange test by the Gods. To reach the other side, there seems to be no other way but to occupy the land of your enemies.

source.other: There is something mystical like a gray atmosphere around these three oases, which no one has found out about yet. Perhaps you will be the one, but be aware of the others who are searching too!

target.other: Det vilar något mystiskt, som en grå atmosfär, över dessa tre oaser. Ingen har ännu fått reda på vad. Kanske blir du den som gör det, men var medveten om att du inte är ensam om att söka!

key: There is something mystical like a gray atmosphere around these three oases, which no one has found out about yet. Perhaps you will be the one, but be aware of the others who are searching too!

source.other: Another thaw set in. Three tribes were sheltering from severe winter among majestic mountains. At the time of the solstice they listened to the oracle and went to war. The only survivor will sacrifice his enemies’ treasures on the ancient altar, build there a splendid castle and gain the goodwill and respect of the Gods.

target.other: Det började töa igen. Tre stammar tog skydd från den stränga vintern bland de majestätiska bergen. Vid vintersolståndet lyssnade de till oraklet och gick i krig. Den enda överlevaren kommer att offra sina fienders skatter på det uråldriga altaret, bygga ett praktfullt slott där och vinna gudarnas välvilja och respekt.

key: Another thaw set in. Three tribes were sheltering from severe winter among majestic mountains. At the time of the solstice they listened to the oracle and went to war. The only survivor will sacrifice his enemies’ treasures on the ancient altar, build there a splendid castle and gain the goodwill and respect of the Gods.

source.other: Mighty mountains divide this land into three fertile valleys. But a path connects the valleys and thus a fight seems inescapable!

target.other: Mäktiga berg delar detta land i tre bördiga dalar. Men en stig förbinder dalarna, och därför verkar ett slag oundvikligt!

key: Mighty mountains divide this land into three fertile valleys. But a path connects the valleys and thus a fight seems inescapable!

source.other: Water can be found around the lakes.

target.other: Vatten finns runt sjöarna.

key: Water can be found around the lakes.

source.other: The four mighty harbors of the Craw Islands have been trading their goods among each other for ages. All of them needed resources that they could not produce in their own territory and in exchange provided other resources to those that could not produce them. Based on these trades, a very friendly commerce was common between the four harbors and the people living on the Craw Islands – until recently, when two of the harbors united to form an exclusive trade alliance, forcing the other two to do the same. Suddenly, it seems only a matter of time before the first fights between the harbors will shatter the peaceful life that has lasted for so long…

target.other: Crawöarnas fyra mäktiga hamnar har handlat med varor sinsemellan i evigheter. De behövde alla resurser som de inte kunde producera i sina egna områden och tillhandahöll i utbyte andra resurser åt dem som inte kunde producera dem. Denna handel gav upphov till ett mycket vänskapligt handelsutbyte mellan de fyra hamnarna och folket på Crawöarna – fram till nyligen, då två av hamnarna gick samman i en exklusiv handelsallians och tvingade de andra två att göra detsamma. Plötsligt verkar det bara vara en tidsfråga innan de första striderna mellan hamnarna krossar det fridfulla liv som har varat så länge …

key: The four mighty harbors of the Craw Islands have been trading their goods among each other for ages. All of them needed resources that they could not produce in their own territory and in exchange provided other resources to those that could not produce them. Based on these trades, a very friendly commerce was common between the four harbors and the people living on the Craw Islands – until recently, when two of the harbors united to form an exclusive trade alliance, forcing the other two to do the same. Suddenly, it seems only a matter of time before the first fights between the harbors will shatter the peaceful life that has lasted for so long…

source.other: When the wind swelled up and the first dunes were formed on these abandoned twin lagoons, nobody could have expected that two tribes that are desperately searching for more resources to support their endlessly ongoing wars, would end up in this forgotten place at the same time and for the same well-known reason.

target.other: När vinden tilltog och de första sanddynerna bildades på dessa övergivna tvillinglaguner kunde ingen förutse att två stammar, som desperat söker resurser för att stödja sina ändlösa krig, skulle hamna på denna glömda plats samtidigt och av samma välkända skäl.

key: When the wind swelled up and the first dunes were formed on these abandoned twin lagoons, nobody could have expected that two tribes that are desperately searching for more resources to support their endlessly ongoing wars, would end up in this forgotten place at the same time and for the same well-known reason.

source.other: The world is not enough! If you want to win, you have to send some ships. But remember: your opponents are very close to you.

target.other: Världen räcker inte till! Om du vill vinna måste du skicka ut några skepp. Men kom ihåg: dina motståndare är mycket nära.

key: The world is not enough! If you want to win, you have to send some ships. But remember: your opponents are very close to you.

source.other: It seems as if this magical valley has been inhabited by wisents since the beginning of days. When your tribe came to this place, you were sure that it offered enough space for a peaceful life. But can your tribe live in peace with your neighbors?

target.other: Det verkar som om denna magiska dal har bebotts av visenter sedan tidernas begynnelse. När din stam kom till platsen var du säker på att den erbjöd tillräckligt med utrymme för ett fridfullt liv. Men kan din stam leva i fred med sina grannar?

key: It seems as if this magical valley has been inhabited by wisents since the beginning of days. When your tribe came to this place, you were sure that it offered enough space for a peaceful life. But can your tribe live in peace with your neighbors?

source.other: The black player is surrounded in the center with no resources, so there are three different ways to use this map: without the black player for a normal 4 players’ map, with a black AI to add a complication to the expansion of the other players, or you can play as a challenge with the black player against the other 4 (VERY difficult).

target.other: Den svarta spelaren är omringad i mitten utan resurser, så det finns tre sätt att använda denna karta: utan den svarta spelaren som en vanlig karta för fyra spelare, med en svart AI-spelare som ett hinder för de andra spelarnas expansion, eller som en utmaning där du spelar den svarta spelaren mot de andra fyra (MYCKET svårt).

key: The black player is surrounded in the center with no resources, so there are three different ways to use this map: without the black player for a normal 4 players’ map, with a black AI to add a complication to the expansion of the other players, or you can play as a challenge with the black player against the other 4 (VERY difficult).
